title: Figure 5: Schematic of super-lens with n=-1 refractive index surrounded by vacuum
description: Schematic showing red arrows (incident waves, labeled "λ > d") passing a wavy periodic grating of spacing d, then through a hatched slab labeled "n=-1", producing a reconstructed wavy image on the far side. Caption: "Figure 5. Schematic of the Super-Lens with n=-1 Refractive Index Corresponding to (ε = -1, μ = -1) Surrounded By Vacuum." Text below discusses sub-surface imaging of small objects, such as cells, buried under liquid.
